description: RFC 6962 Merkle root over four leaves. Generated by warrantor-trust-core::merkle::merkle_root. Cross-language implementations (Python, Go) must produce the identical root for the same leaf set.
ordering: RFC 6962 — leaf=SHA-256(0x00 || leaf), node=SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), orphan-promotion for odd layers
notes: The Rust unit test in rust/trust-core/src/merkle.rs::tests::determinism locks this; cross-language conformance enforces the same root in Python and Go.
